limitations:
PARTIAL SCOPE: the 6 phosphoproteome RAW files (20190618_CF_COLLAB_Dan_A375_SILAC_0_30_120_STY_01_01/_01_02/_02_01/_02_02/_03_01/_03_02.raw) are NOT annotated (rule 7). The preprint WAS read: lines 229-231 say "4h treatment with A922500", and Fig. 3A shows A375 Light = DMSO, Heavy = A922500, 4h, so the agent is known. Three real blockers remain:
(1) The deposit is triple SILAC (summary_ST Multiplicity 3, M = Arg6;Lys4), but no text or figure documents the medium channel; it appears only in the code name STY_30m.
(2) The file names say 0_30_120 (heavy = 120 min), which conflicts with the 4h stated in the preprint text, Fig. 3A and the code (STY_4h).
(3) The stated map fails the rule-6 data check. RPS6 S235/S236 H/L normalized is 1.42-1.55 / 2.02-2.29 (up) in all 3 experiments (rps6_check.txt), while the preprint reports loss of pS6 within 2-4 h of A922500 (lines 235-238, Fig. 3B).
Unblocked by: author confirmation of the medium channel and the label orientation. See annotations/BLOCKED.md.

The 24 short-term proteome runs (20190618_CF_COLLAB_Dan_A375_SILAC_0_30_120_PRO_0[1-3]_0[1-8]) were searched together with the phospho runs (experimentalDesignTemplate_phosphoproteome.txt, summary_ST.txt) but are not deposited in PRIDE; nothing to annotate.

Precursor mass tolerance 7 ppm is from paper prose only; no mqpar.xml was deposited. The paper also states MaxQuant 1.5.6.5 while the deposited parameters.txt says 1.6.2.6 (deposit preferred; version not encoded in the SDRF).
DMSO-vehicle exposure duration for the light channel is not stated -> characteristics[sampling time] not available on rows 1-24.
A922500 has no NCIT/EFO term; written as free text (parser warning). Dose 30 uM (paper Compounds section, general statement) not encoded.

Label-direction cross-check: NRF2/FAO markers and PLIN2 behave as expected for heavy=A922500, but SESN2 (H/L 0.84-1.04) and SOD1 (1.02-1.16) are not clearly up in this proteome although the paper reports their induction by western blot in Figure S6B (different experiment); not treated as contradicting the map.
techsdrf not installed; instrument verified by HTTP-range reading RAW headers instead. parse_sdrf exit 0 proves well-formedness only.
GitHub analysis repository read via anonymous git clone of a public repo (commit 1f9fafa); add_repo was not used.
cell type, individual, passage number and sample storage temperature are not stated -> not available.
